subject: Future Tech
title: Cybersecurity on Wheels
description: A quick win: understand Cybersecurity on Wheels.

hook.text: A hacker remotely takes control of a self-driving car doing 70 mph. It's not science fiction.

buildup.text: AVs are rolling computers connected to the internet.

discovery.text: Security researchers hacked a Jeep in 2015, controlling steering and brakes remotely.

twist.text: A coordinated attack on a robotaxi fleet could cause traffic chaos, accidents, or hold a city's transport hostage.

climax.text: AV companies now employ top cybersecurity teams.

punchline.text: Self-driving cars need firewalls as strong as their brakes.

quiz.question: What happened in the 2015 Jeep hack?
options: Researchers remotely controlled the car's steering and brakes
The car's camera was blinded with a laser
